senses.gloss: m. a species or variety of dates; date-tree (v. כּוֹתֶבֶת).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 14b:8">Ab. Zar. 14ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01493"><he>חֲצָב</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 58b:15">B. Kam. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>קץ ק׳ מחבריה</he> (Ms. H. <cite ref="S01220"><he>קִישְׁ׳</he></cite>; Alf. <cite ref="S01633"><he>קסבא</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) cut one of his neighbor’s date-trees.—Pl. <he>קִשְׁבֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Megillah 7b:3">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>מלא טסקא דק׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דקשבא</he>) a basketful of dates; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1059">Yalk. Esth. 1059</cite>.
